shared_elements: rosette/radiating floral motif with central round boss
petals radiating symmetrically from a disc
shallow low-relief carving of the motif
justification: Both surfaces show the same specific motif of a many-petalled rosette radiating from a raised central boss, rendered in shallow relief with regular, evenly spaced pointed petals, which is a reasonably conventional correspondence. However, A's rosettes are small and repeated as a subsidiary border band above a large figural scene of a humped animal led by a striding human with a staff, while B depicts nothing but a single monumental rosette filling the field, with no figures at all.
